subject: Sponsor briefing — business outcomes, risk gating, procurement path
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sana Malik <sana.malik@cardiofit.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsor briefing — business outcomes, risk gating, procurement path

Hi Sana (and team),

Thanks again for carving out time today with the CardioFit leadership panel. Short recap and agreed next steps so we have a single source of truth for sponsors and procurement.

Key business outcomes discussed
- Reduce inference latency for real-time ECG triage from ~400ms to target <=150ms for on-device + cloud path; primary KPI is time-to-alert and clinician adoption in pilot.
- Improve per-prediction cost by ~3x vs current provider through batching + quantization in pilot.
- Pilot to validate clinical uplift (sensitivity uplift target: +4–6%) before broader rollout.

Top risks / gating items (sponsor view)
1) Data residency / audit logs — CardioFit must retain request logs for 7 years for regulatory review; determine Private deployment or VPC option.
2) SLA & liability language — leadership wants service-levels mapped to alerting guarantees for pilot and production.
3) Procurement window — finance expects an approved purchase order by end of Q3 for pilot to start in Q4.

Procurement path & owners (what we agreed)
- Sana (Sponsor) will brief CFO and procurement lead; procurement contact is procurement@cardiofit.com.
- CardioFit requests an initial 3-month pilot SOW, followed by 12-month reserved capacity if KPIs met.
- Decision checkpoints: steering review at pilot week-4 and week-8.

Immediate asks (action owners & timeline)
- Lauren / Redwood: provide a clean SLA + pilot SOW draft (by EOD Wed, Apr 21) and a short technical appendix on on-prem / VPC options (Marcus).
- Marcus: supply model performance profile and sequence-length expectations for cost modeling (due Apr 23).
- CardioFit (Sana): confirm procurement contact and internal budget window (by Apr 20).

Attachments: I’ve attached the post-call notes and a working template SLA for initial review.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate a short pilot kick-off invite if procurement confirms timeline.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: post-call-mpp-notes.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Sana Malik <sana.malik@cardiofit.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Arjun Rao <arjun.rao@cardiofit.com>, CardioFit Procurement <procurement@cardiofit.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Sponsor briefing — business outcomes, risk gating, procurement path

Thanks Lauren — crisp notes, appreciated. Quick clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement lead: Arjun Rao (cc’d). He is handling contract terms and will need the SLA + SOW to start redlines.
- Budget: CFO said there is a Q3 window for pilot spend but we need PO approvals in late July; pilot needs to be scoped small enough to fit the FY23 pilot line.
- Data residency: we will need either a VPC deployment in our preferred region or a written plan showing how logs are stored and exported for audits.

I attached our procurement questionnaire (CardioFit_Procurement_Questions.xlsx) — Arjun, this covers most of the legal/tech gating items.

Next steps from CardioFit: I’ll confirm PO owner and timeline by EOD Apr 21. If Redwood can get the SLA + SOW draft by Apr 21, we can circulate internally the same week.

Sana Malik
VP, Clinical Ops | CardioFit
sana.malik@cardiofit.com | +1 (212) 555-0116

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sana Malik <sana.malik@cardiofit.com>, Arjun Rao <arjun.rao@cardiofit.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sponsor briefing — business outcomes, risk gating, procurement path

Folks — looping you in with Sana’s procurement questionnaire attached. Pulling out the internal asks:

Marcus:
- Can you produce a one-page technical appendix that covers the following by EOD Apr 23: expected token distribution, latency curve at 1/5/10k RPS, and options for VPC vs private node deployments? This will feed Arjun’s security review.

Monica:
- Please draft a pilot SOW (3-month) + simple success criteria and a steering cadence (week-4, week-8). Target to have a draft SLA + SOW to share with CardioFit by end-of-day Wed Apr 21.

Karthik:
- Prepare a short cost comparison (hosted vs reserved vs private) focusing on projected per-prediction cost at pilot volume — due Apr 23.

I’ve attached a first-pass SLA we can iterate on. Note: this version is intentionally conservative on uptime but we can update thresholds post-technical review.

Thanks — if we hit these dates we should be able to get procurement the docs they need to start redlines and keep the Q3 window open.

— Lauren

Attachments: Redwood-Prod-SLA-draft.pdf (PDF), post-call-mpp-notes.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Arjun Rao <arjun.rao@cardiofit.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Sana Malik <sana.malik@cardiofit.com>
Cc: CardioFit Procurement <procurement@cardiofit.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Sponsor briefing — business outcomes, risk gating, procurement path

Lauren / Sana — thanks for the summary and the questionnaire. A couple quick procurement points: 

- I’m the primary contract lead; procurement@cardiofit.com forwards to our legal intake system. We’ll open a ticket once we receive the SLA + SOW drafts.
- Typical turnaround: 5–7 business days for initial redlines (depending on legal load). If you can get the SLA + SOW into DocuSign or Google Drive by EOD Apr 21, we will try to prioritize review.
- Our must-haves: audit log export (S3-compatible), role-based access control mapping, and an explicit data retention clause (7 years). If Redwood offers a Private/VPC deployment diagram, that will expedite our security review.

On timing: if we receive the materials by Apr 21 and they map to our must-haves, procurement can aim to issue an LOI by Jul 28 for the Q3 window you described.

Arjun Rao
Head of Procurement | CardioFit
arjun.rao@cardiofit.com | +1 (617) 555-0942
